import time
import unittest

import login

class TestLogin(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_login_sets_token(self):
        login.start_login("ana")
        time.sleep(0.02)  # usually enough for the worker
        self.assertEqual(login.SESSION.get("token"), "tok-ana")

    def test_logout_clears_session(self):
        login.SESSION["token"] = "tok-x"
        login.logout()
        self.assertEqual(login.SESSION, {})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
